Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing cities to impose a tax on water-sewer district services provided within the city.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the equality of utility taxation on water andsewer services provided within cities and towns; and adding a newsection to chapter 35.21 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A city or town in which a watersewer district operates works,plants, or facilities for the distribution and sale of water or sewerservices has the power to levy and collect from the district a tax onthe gross revenues derived by the district from the sale of water orsewer services within the city or town, exclusive of the revenuesderived from the sale of water or sewer services for purposes ofresale. The tax when levied shall be a debt of the district, and maybe collected as such. The district has the power to add the amount oftax to the rates or charges it makes for water or sewer services soldwithin the limits of the city or town.
